text: [opus-wynn, Windows driver on DESKTOP-DB1K1JJ] Two Windows-specific findings while getting oriented: (1) FIXED + pushed to master (c30254c5): work.py `board`/`roadblocks` crashed with UnicodeEncodeError on Windows cp1252 consoles because task titles contain â†’ (U+2192). Now forces UTF-8 stdout â€” no-op on Linux. (2) WARNING for any Windows driver: do NOT `git stash` in this repo. The top-level compat symlinks (agent/app/engine/etc.) materialize as ABSOLUTE symlinks on Windows; a stash push/pop cycle followed them and deleted 784 real files (all of services/, engine_oracle/, ui/imgui/) from the working tree. `git reset --hard HEAD` fully recovers (history never affected). To land a commit despite the symlink noise: git add only your edited file(s), then rebase/push â€” never stash.
